claims.claim: Qwen3.8-Max is a 2.4-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model activating 95 billion parameters per token.
Qwen3.8-Max lists at $2.00 per 1M input tokens and $6.00 per 1M output tokens, with implicit cache reads at $0.25 per 1M.
The $2/$6 rate is a single flat tier covering the entire 1M-token context, with no long-context step-up.
Alibaba's launch table reports Terminal-Bench 2.1 scores of 86.6 for Qwen3.8-Max against 84.6 for Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Fable 5, and 88.8 for GPT-5.6 Sol.
Qwen evaluated its own model on Terminal-Bench 2.1 using the Claude Code harness at avg@10 with a 5-hour timeout and max_tokens=131,072.
On WideSearch, Qwen states it used the Claude Code harness for external models and the Qwen-Agent harness for its own model.
Harness choice alone swings terminal-agent benchmark scores by far more than Qwen's claimed margin, with GPT-5.5 measured at 82.7 under Codex CLI versus 53.5 under Terminus-2.
In a blind, matched-scaffold independent evaluation on a single architecture task, Kimi K3 scored 83/100 against Qwen3.8-Max-Preview's 80/100.
Alibaba's own launch blog states both '10+ Days of Autonomous Coding' and 'approximately 16 days of fully autonomous AI operation' for the same run.
The artifact offered as proof of the autonomy claim is the repository qwen-code-dev-bot/oh-my-cli, created 2026-07-13T11:43:52Z, Apache-2.0 licensed and written in TypeScript.
The repository's contributor list records 463 contributions from the bot account and 13 from a human account, qqqys.
A human commit (59eca7c, 2026-07-23) inside the claimed autonomy window modified the agent's coordinator prompt and community policy, adding 71 lines and deleting 9 across three files.
No agent-authored work commit in the repository is cryptographically signed; the GitHub API reports verification reason 'unsigned'.

METR states that its time-horizon metric measures the length of human task a model can complete at 50% success, not how long a model can work independently, and its best measured 50% horizon is about 17 hours.

Alibaba published effort metrics for its paper-reproduction demo — about five days, roughly 125 compute hours, 7,600 lines of code and 33 rounds of GPU training — but published no effort metric for the 16-day coding run.
As of 2026-08-04 no Qwen3.8 repository exists in the Hugging Face Qwen organization; the most recently modified repository dates from 2026-07-22.
Every Max-tier Qwen flagship since Qwen3-Max-Preview in September 2025 has shipped closed-weight, with no Max-class checkpoint ever released.
No license has been named for the promised Qwen3.8 open weights in any first-party English or Chinese channel.

Artificial Analysis measures Qwen3.8-Max at Intelligence Index 53, 46.5 output tokens per second, and $2,159.51 to run its Intelligence Index on 150M output tokens, labelling the model 'very verbose'.
DeepSeek disclosed a 545% cost-profit ratio on V3/R1 inference, based on $87,072 of daily cost at an assumed $2 per H800 GPU-hour against $562,027 of theoretical daily revenue.
LMSYS measured a serving cost of $0.20 per 1M output tokens for DeepSeek V3 on 96 H100 GPUs using wide expert parallelism, about one-fifth DeepSeek's own API price.
Decode cost for a sparse MoE tracks total parameters through memory bandwidth rather than active parameters, so an eight-way-sparse MoE serves roughly like a dense model of half its total size.
Alibaba's US-listed shares closed up 4.14% at $127.31 on 2026-08-03, while the Hong Kong line closed about 7% higher at HK$125.20.
Alibaba's FY2026 capital expenditure reached RMB 126.06 billion and full-year free cash flow swung to an outflow of RMB 46.6 billion.
Alibaba Cloud Intelligence revenue was RMB 41.626 billion in the quarter ended 2026-03-31, up 38% year over year, with AI-related products at roughly 30% of external cloud revenue.

No enacted US federal law or regulation restricts downloading, hosting, or using Chinese open-weight models as of 2026-08-04; the No Adversarial AI Act remains in committee with one recorded action since 2025-06-25.

Alibaba was designated on the DoD Section 1260H Chinese Military Companies list published 2026-06-10, and the FY2024 NDAA Section 805 bar on DoD contracting with listed entities took effect 2026-06-30.
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's default inference scope is 'Global', which explicitly includes nodes inside China unless a model name carries the -us suffix.
The domestic Chinese price for Qwen3.8-Max is RMB 12 per 1M input and RMB 36 per 1M output tokens, identical to the rate Qwen3.7-Max carried.
Qwen's own published harness configuration for Qwen3.8-Max declares an effective context window of 95 percent of the nominal 1M-token limit.
